payload.name: Extract each subject's action in multi-event messages
payload.description: When a message reports distinct actions by different people, especially with 'while', 'during', or 'at the same time', extract a separate candidate memory for each subject's event.
content: During extraction, treat each independently verifiable fact in a message as a separate candidate; do not let a prominent topic suppress other subjects.
When a message uses temporal conjunctions such as 'while', 'during', or 'at the same time', extract a distinct memory for each subject's activity on either side of the conjunction.
Do not merge two subjects' distinct events into one memory; if a memory already exists for one part, add the other part as a separate memory or update appropriately.

solves: Messages often bundle multiple people's concurrent actions using temporal connectors like 'while' or 'during'; extraction can capture only the more salient subject and lose the other, making memories incomplete. This skill provides a targeted rule to split multi-subject temporal clauses into separate extraction candidates, preserving all durable facts in future conversations.
